verdict.rationale: Wave is small-business accounting SaaS. A product like this could plausibly ship an in-product AI assistant that connects to MCP servers, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Wave acting as an MCP client, and the crawl note states its public pages document no API, MCP, CLI, or webhook surface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
